name: Baal-peor

related_people.name: Phinehas
related_people.role: struck down Zimri and Cozbi at the height of Israel's idolatry here, stopping the plague

description: The site of a local Baal shrine where Israelite men were drawn into idolatry and sexual immorality with Moabite women, a plague-provoking sin that Phinehas's decisive action helped end (Numbers 25).
